'''Delt Nerris''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and a sympathizer of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Corellian Security Force]]s organized a joint operation using the ship illegally-modified [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|Short Hauler]] ''[[Nova Whisper]]'', that had been captured from the pirate [[Dharus]], as a bait for criminals. Delt Nerris was assigned to pilot the ship. Making use of his chance, Nerris hijacked the ship and gave it to the forces of the Alliance. The Alliance then added the ship to its forces on [[Asher III]].<ref name="Stock Ships" />
